description: This PHP class 'EndpointUpdateResult' extends 'AbstractEndpointResult' and provides a method 'normalize' to convert the endpoint result into an array format. It is part of the OrangeHRM system's API V2 serialization component, specifically handling the update result of an endpoint.

classes.name: EndpointUpdateResult
classes.description: A class indicating the result of an endpoint update operation, with normalization capabilities.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the normalized array representation of the object by calling 'normalizeObject()'.
